overview: Hindustan Copper Limited (HCL) is a public sector undertaking under the Ministry of Mines, Government of India, established on 9 November 1967. It is the nation's only vertically integrated copper producing company, engaged in mining, beneficiation, smelting, refining, and production of refined copper metal and by-products such as gold, silver, copper sulphate, and sulphuric acid. The company operates mines and plants across Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Jharkhand, Maharashtra, and Gujarat, and focuses on mining and beneficiation, primarily selling copper concentrate as its main product.

eligibility: The Contributory Post Retirement Medical Scheme (CPRMS) 2026 provides insurance coverage for superannuated employees and/or their spouse, with an IPD sum insured of Rs. 5 Lakhs per person (clubbing allowed between primary member and spouse, maximum limit of Rs. 10 Lakhs per family). Corporate buffer of Rs. 1 Crore is available for the overall policy period on a 'First-Come-First Served' basis with a ceiling of Rs. 5 Lakhs for each member. OPD sum insured is Rs. 20 Thousand per member, with clubbing allowed between primary member and spouse (maximum limit of Rs. 40 Thousand per family).
benefits: The CPRMS 2026 scheme provides insurance coverage for both IPD and OPD. IPD Sum Insured: Rs. 5 Lakhs per person (Superannuated employee and/or Spouse), with clubbing allowed between Primary member & spouse (Maximum limit of Rs. 10 Lakhs per family). Corporate Buffer: Rs. 1 Crore for the overall policy period to be used on 'First-Come-First Served basis' with ceiling of Rs. 5 Lakhs for each member. OPD Sum Insured (Over & above IPD Sum Insured): Entitlement of Rs.20 Thousand per member with Sum Insured Clubbing allowed between Primary Member & spouse (Maximum limit of Rs.40 Thousand per family). Bed/Cabin charges depend on pre-superannuation grade: All Workmen Rs. 2550 per day, Grade E-0, E-1 & E-2 Rs. 3750 per day, Grade E-3 to E-5 Rs. 4500 per day, Grade E-6 to E-7 Rs. 5550 per day, Grade E-8 & E-9 Rs. 6750 per day, CMD / Directors Rs. 14250 per day. For admission in ICCU/ITU/ICU/HDU, charges are a percentage of sum insured: All Workmen 1.5%, Grade E-0, E-1 & E-2 2%, Grade E-3 to E-5 2%, Grade E-6 to E-7 3%, Grade E-8 & E-9 3%, CMD / Directors 4%. The cover extends 30 days pre-hospitalization and 60 days post-hospitalization benefits. All pre-existing diseases/ailments are covered without any medical test for all existing superannuated employees/spouse including additions during the policy currency. All pre-existing diseases/conditions and all future medical conditions are covered from day one of the policy without any waiting period. Coverage continues for the spouse in case of death of the Primary Member during the policy period. Any treatment (IPD/OPD/Day care) recommended by a Registered Medical Practitioner, including emerging or non-standard medical procedures, is fully covered. All advanced/radiological/robotic/specialized therapies are covered. Any new or evolving treatment modality approved by the treating doctor is payable. Domiciliary/Home Hospitalization is covered whenever hospital admission is not possible due to clinical or logistical reasons. Ambulance expenses are admissible up to Rs.10,000 per hospitalization for admission, discharge, or inter-hospital transfer, subject to submission of valid money receipt(s) issued by a registered ambulance service provider. Air Ambulance is covered in life-threatening situations. Recipient and donor medical and hospitalization expenses are covered except the cost of the organ. Hospitalization for Psychiatric/Mental health ailments is covered up to the applicable Sum Insured, including acute episodes, behavioural disorders, neurological treatments, and related medical complications requiring inpatient care. Coverage includes Functional Endoscopic Sinus Surgery (FESS), Septoplasty, and all ENT-related surgeries/procedures necessitating hospitalization, payable up to the full Sum Insured without any additional sub-limits. Lasik Surgery is covered if correction index is +/-6.5D. Cost of Multi focal lenses/Toric Lenses/all similar kind lenses is covered in case of Cataract surgeries. All internal and external congenital anomalies (except cosmetic), HIV/AIDS and related complications are fully covered. Treatment expenses directly or indirectly associated with HIV/AIDS and other retro-viral diseases are fully covered as per policy terms up to the Sum Insured. All modern, advanced, high-end, or minimally invasive medical treatments, including but not limited to Cyber-Knife, Stem Cell Therapy, Cochlear Implant, Femto Laser, Minimal Access/Key-hole CABG, Balloon Kyphoplasty, Hormonal Therapy, etc., are fully covered. Fees of Doctors/Surgeons/Anaesthetists/Medical Practitioners are fully covered as per actuals, upon submission of either Independent Money Receipt issued by the Practitioner or inclusion of such fees as part of the Hospital/Clinic Bill. All types of Cancer-related treatments and therapies are fully covered under the policy including but not limited to Chemotherapy, Radiotherapy, Immunotherapy/Targeted therapy, Hormonal therapy, Brachytherapy, Onco-surgeries, Advanced and minimally invasive procedures, supportive treatments required as a consequence of cancer therapy. Quantum Magnetic Resonance Therapy and Retrograde Intra renal surgery are covered. Physiotherapy expenses are covered as per actuals when recommended by the attending/treating doctor, including sessions taken at home during the Post-Hospitalization period. All types of Genetic Disorders are covered without any exclusion or limitation. In IPD claims, where Resident Medical Officer (RMO), Attendant, or Nursing expenses are billed separately and over and above the room rent limit, such charges are fully payable in addition to the eligible room rent amount and are not restricted to room rent sub-limits. All types of OPD treatment including Dental & Eye (consultation fees, diagnostic (pathology/radiology) tests/Investigations - preventive or illness related, medicines, Medical instruments/devices, procedures, routine health check-up, medical consumables & non-medical items, orthopaedic braces/supports, vaccination any type, Dressing items, Spectacles, Lenses, Hearing Aids, etc.) are fully covered. OPD claims are processed irrespective of whether a diagnosis is mentioned in the prescription. Doctor fees above Rs. 500/- are supported with proper money receipt; fees below Rs.500/- are accepted even if handwritten on the prescription. Bills for investigations without reports are payable if supporting Doctor’s Prescription is available. Health check-ups are payable with or without prescription. All OPD care/process is treated as covered even if not explicitly listed in the tender. Any non-medical deductions from IPD claims are processed under OPD Claim (up to OPD SI limit). OPD reimbursement claims may be submitted at any time during the policy period, but claims must be submitted within 90 days from the date of the bill(s) or when cumulative OPD expenses exceed Rs.4,000/- per member, whichever is earlier. HCL, through its registered Third Party Administrator (TPA), has operationalized a dedicated Help Desk at the Corporate Office, HCL, Kolkata, functioning on all working days throughout the policy period, to facilitate beneficiaries in submission of documents, lodging and tracking of claims, and resolution of medical-related queries, thereby ensuring easy access, timely assistance, and enhanced convenience in availing policy benefits. In case cashless facility is availed under the policy, any non-admissible amount or deductions imposed by the Insurance Company/TPA are directly recovered from the beneficiary concerned. HCL has no liability or responsibility whatsoever for recovery of such non-admissible amounts and is not involved in any manner in settlement between the Insurance Company/TPA and the beneficiary.

application_process: 1. Check the nearest empanelled hospital from the Network Hospital List available on the FHPL website. 2. Inform the TPA about IPD hospitalization at the earliest via email, with a copy marked to HCL and the Mediclaim Consultant at the designated email IDs. 3. Visit the hospital’s Insurance/TPA Desk with your Health Card, valid ID proof, doctor’s advice, and treatment-related all medical documents. 4. Upon commencement of treatment, the member’s relative must complete and submit the Pre-authorization Form at the hospital’s TPA desk. 5. The hospital shall forward all required documents to the TPA for verification of eligibility. 6. Initial approval shall be provided by the TPA within six (06) working hours upon receipt of complete documents. 7. The TPA shall settle the claim within 10 working days of receipt of complete documents, and the settlement amount shall be credited directly to the primary member’s bank account. 8. Final approval shall be issued by the TPA within 2–4 hours after receipt of the discharge summary, reports, and final bills. 9. In case of denial, the TPA shall inform the hospital with reasons; inadmissible expenses shall be borne by the member, and payment receipts along with copies of relevant documents should be retained for record (refer Annexure-C).
required_documents: soft copies of bills, prescriptions, discharge summaries, diagnostic reports
hard copies (in exceptional cases with proper justification and prior intimation to HCL)
Treating doctor’s certificate giving details of injuries (Detailed narration of the incident with date, time and place) including whether Claimant was under the influence of any intoxicating material
KYC documents of the primary member (Aadhaar & PAN card)
copy of a cancelled cheque of the primary member with the name printed on it
deadlines: IPD reimbursement claims, including post-hospitalization expenses, must be submitted within 60 days from the date of discharge; however, post-hospitalization claims shall be submitted within 7 days of completion of treatment or within 60 days from the date of discharge, whichever is earlier. In genuine cases such as prolonged treatment, delayed discharge summary, or unavoidable circumstances, the above timelines may be relaxed with approval of HCL. If a claim is closed due to missing or insufficient documents, it can be reopened during the policy period and up to 90 days after policy expiry upon submission of the required documents. OPD claims must be submitted to the TPA within 90 days from the billing date or upon the expenses exceeding Rs.4,000/- per member, whichever occurs first.
